_comment: Where a café's own published page is recorded, if it has one. Empty here on purpose: this repository is public, and these were the addresses of the owner's own private pages, so they live in her environment instead -- CATIO_ARTIFACT for the retired café artifact, which is still read for the licensed art (CLAUDE.md, "The licensed art"). A check in harness/test/test_hooks.py keeps them out. Someone setting a café up of their own publishes their own artifact and records its URL here, in their own fork, never over anyone else's (catio-plugin/skills/catio/SKILL.md).
